metadata.database: A Deeper China | Wudang point decision layer

WDG001.guest_value: Connect mountain landscape, Taoist building tradition and public heritage.
WDG001.choose_rule: Use before naming buildings or viewpoints.
WDG001.stop_after: The heritage system is legible beyond fantasy imagery.

WDG002.guest_value: Read imperial patronage and construction as part of the story.
WDG002.choose_rule: Use when the guest wants history rather than mysticism.

WDG003.guest_value: Separate public heritage from private temples, practitioners and training spaces.
WDG003.choose_rule: Use before any access or master request.
WDG003.stop_after: The visitor accepts a public alternative.

WDG004.guest_value: Test whether two nights can hold a focused public visit.
WDG004.choose_rule: Use with arrival, weather and mobility facts.
WDG004.stop_after: The two-night route is either accepted or rejected.

WDG005.guest_value: Use extra nights for weather buffer and a separately vetted low-intensity option.
WDG005.choose_rule: Do not treat extra nights as automatic training access.
WDG005.stop_after: The added time has a distinct purpose.

WDG006.guest_value: Protect the first day from late arrival and last-mile uncertainty.
WDG006.choose_rule: Use before emitting a day-one route.
WDG006.stop_after: Arrival and first usable block are realistic.

WDG007.choose_rule: Use before any mountain or sunrise plan.
WDG007.stop_after: The visitor accepts the exertion threshold.

WDG008.guest_value: Turn weather changes into a different day plan.
WDG008.choose_rule: Use when rain, storm, wind or cold is plausible.
WDG008.stop_after: A safe fallback preserves the main question.

WDG009.choose_rule: Check current operation, queues and warnings.
WDG009.stop_after: Cable-car dependency is removed or dated evidence exists.

WDG010.guest_value: Connect one building, slope and viewpoint coherently.
WDG010.choose_rule: Use only after a current field walk.

WDG011.choose_rule: Use when the primary route fails weather or energy checks.
WDG011.stop_after: The fallback remains coherent and safe.

WDG012.guest_value: Separate photo interest from a promised sunrise, mist or empty scene.
WDG012.stop_after: The visitor accepts conditions may override the photo goal.

WDG013.guest_value: Make clothing, quiet, consent and photography rules explicit.

WDG014.guest_value: Offer architecture and landscape without requiring worship.
WDG014.stop_after: The visitor has a comfortable public route.

WDG015.guest_value: Redirect master, ritual and private-space requests.

WDG016.guest_value: Separate observation, recreation, training and healing.
WDG016.choose_rule: Ask purpose, health limits, language and schedule first.

WDG017.guest_value: Show evidence required before a Tai Chi session can be mentioned.
WDG017.choose_rule: All provider and safety gates must pass.

WDG018.guest_value: Explain why training and healing are outside the default product.
WDG018.choose_rule: No medical, therapeutic or professional-placement promise.

WDG019.guest_value: Choose a base from sleep, food, arrival and fallback needs.
WDG019.choose_rule: Use actual dates and mobility constraints.

WDG020.guest_value: Make dated evidence and unresolved risk visible.
WDG020.choose_rule: Use before calling any route human-checked.
WDG020.stop_after: The output is released, revised or paused.
